facts.evidence_text: Statement of Jequan Davis, 2026-11-27: Joan Ellen Davis of Millsboro, Delaware is his maternal grandmother, living; her profile is created at his direction with no dates displayed, per the archive's living-people rule.

1950 United States Federal Census, Delaware, Sussex, Delaware, USA. Dwelling record #1200590. The household enumeration names 'Joan Ellen Davis (Granddaughter, age 3)' with her mother Phoebe Davis in the same house; the same census fact and citation sit on her sister Maryland Phoebe Davis's profile (fact 16134).

person.name: Joan Ellen Davis
person.notes: [Created by joan-davis-profile package 2026-11-27.] Living; no dates are displayed for living people. Daughter of William Wesley Davis Sr and Phoebe Thompson Davis of Millsboro, Delaware. Mother of Sandra Davis, Jane Davis, and Toney Floyd, named as her children in her sister Maryland Phoebe Davis's funeral program (Watson Funeral Home, 2020), which records that Maryland helped raise them. Enumerated in the 1950 census as Joan Ellen Davis, granddaughter, in the Millsboro household of her grandparents Samuel and Martha Thompson, with her mother Phoebe Davis in the same house.

relationships.evidence_text: 1950 US Federal Census (source 862): Joan Ellen Davis is enumerated as granddaughter in the household of her grandparents Samuel and Martha Thompson, with her mother Phoebe (Thompson) Davis in the same house. Corroborated by the funeral program of her sister Maryland Phoebe Davis (source 2700), which names Phoebe (Thompson) Davis as Maryland's mother and Joan Davis as Maryland's sister.

Funeral program of Maryland Phoebe Davis (Watson Funeral Home, 2020; source 2700): Maryland 'was born in Millsboro, Delaware on June 30, 1939 to the late William Wesley Davis and Phoebe (Thompson) Davis,' and her survivors include 'her sister Joan Davis.' Joan Ellen Davis is William Wesley Davis Sr's daughter by the same parentage, confirmed by Jequan Davis's family knowledge (statement source, this package).
